title: Public Alert No. 041/2026 – Alert on Suspected Counterfeit ORACIRE+ Toothpaste
summary: NAFDAC warns that counterfeit "ORACIRE+ Toothpaste" is circulating in Nigeria, mimicking the registered ORACARE+ Toothpaste by Aspira Nigeria Limited. Found at Ojuwoye Market, Mushin, Lagos. Buy only from authorized outlets and check packaging.
